scope: Aggregate only JOB-requested work newly requested after the later of production READY/alias assignment/explicit cutoff. Existing queued work, member/admin requests and the historical 19-job cohort are excluded.

databaseBinding.limitation: Environment metadata was authenticated earlier on 2026-10-07, not fetched by this DB-only probe.

limitation: A bounded point-in-time aggregate, not proof that every connected account is complete. JOB category and the post-promotion time window do not identify the exact deployment of every worker; no individual job/identity/body is retained.
